name: Configure AI agent to MCP server with fs write + DB + API access
description: MCP server gives AI agent production database + filesystem write + API call permissions
simulation_steps: [{"order": 1, "role": "cli", "description": "Create an MCP server configuration file granting filesystem write, database, and API access", "command": "mkdir -p /home/user/.config/claude-desktop && printf '{\\n  \"mcpServers\": {\\n    \"workspace-tools\": {\\n      \"command\": \"npx\",\\n      \"args\": [\"-y\", \"@anthropic/mcp-filesystem\"],\\n      \"env\": {\\n        \"ALLOWED_PATHS\": \"/\"\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n' > /home/user/.config/claude-desktop/claude_desktop_config.json", "expected_artifact": "mcp_config_created_with_broad_permissions", "timeout_seconds": 15}, {"order": 2, "role": "cli", "description": "Restart the Claude Desktop application to load the new MCP configuration", "command": "echo 'Claude Desktop would restart with new MCP config'", "expected_artifact": "claude_desktop_restarted_with_mcp_config", "timeout_seconds": 20}, {"order": 3, "role": "cli", "description": "Verify the MCP server is connected and has broad permissions", "command": "cat /home/user/.config/claude-desktop/claude_desktop_config.json", "expected_artifact": "mcp_server_config_shows_broad_permissions", "timeout_seconds": 10}]
coach_intervention: At MCP connect: 'fs write + DB read + API call. Agent gets prod access. Limit to read-only?'
success_metric: ≥90% MCP config detection, correct permission parsing, least-privilege suggestion
test_data: Test MCP server (Node.js). claude_desktop_config.json / .cursor config. Permission scope definitions
